questions.subtopic: Matching Headings (Passage 1: Fertile Crescent Agriculture)
questions.question:
Paragraph: 'By cultivating dense monocultures of wheat and barley, Neolithic communities unintentionally depleted micronutrients in alluvial soils, necessitating fallow rotations and organic soil replenishment through animal manure. This agricultural intensification also facilitated the transmission of zoonotic pathogens from livestock to human hosts, introducing tuberculosis and measles to crowded mudbrick settlements.'

Which heading best expresses the main idea of this paragraph?
options: Methods of domesticating cattle and caprines in upper Mesopotamia
Archaeological evidence for the eradication of prehistoric infectious diseases
Unforeseen ecological degradation and epidemiological consequences of sedentary farming
The chemical composition of alluvial river valleys in the Fertile Crescent
questions.explanation: The paragraph focuses on two major negative outcomes of intensive farming: soil nutrient depletion (ecological) and the transfer of zoonotic pathogens like measles and TB (epidemiological). 'Unforeseen ecological degradation and epidemiological consequences of sedentary farming' captures both core arguments.

questions.subtopic: Matching Headings (Passage 2: Deep-Sea Manganese Nodules)
questions.question:
Paragraph: 'Proposed commercial seabed extraction techniques utilize heavy tracked harvesting vehicles that scrape the top twenty centimetres of abyssal mud. Beyond the physical annihilation of nodule-dependent communities, this process generates dense sediment plumes that linger in suspension across ocean currents for weeks, potentially clogging the filter-feeding apparatus of midwater pelagic species.'

Which heading best summarizes this paragraph?
options: Engineering breakthroughs in subsea robotic propulsion systems
Environmental ramifications: Habitat obliteration and suspended particulate plumes
The global market demand for nickel and cobalt in battery manufacturing
International legal jurisdiction over outer continental shelf resources
questions.explanation: The paragraph explores two direct impacts of seabed mining: the physical destruction of benthic communities and the damaging suspension plumes that affect pelagic organisms. Heading 'Environmental ramifications: Habitat obliteration and suspended particulate plumes' summarizes this completely.

questions.subtopic: Multiple Choice (Passage 3: Neuroplasticity in Bilinguals)
questions.question: According to epidemiological studies cited in the text, how does bilingualism influence the clinical manifestation of Alzheimer's disease?
options: It delays the onset of observable clinical symptoms by four to five years through enhanced cognitive reserve, despite equivalent underlying neuropathology
It prevents the physical formation of amyloid-beta plaques in brain tissue
It eliminates all forms of age-related memory deterioration entirely
It restricts neurodegenerative decline exclusively to the primary auditory cortex
questions.explanation: Studies by Bialystok and colleagues demonstrate that bilinguals show clinical dementia symptoms 4 to 5 years later than monolinguals, not because brain pathology is absent, but because enhanced cognitive reserve allows them to compensate longer.

questions.question:
Paragraph: 'Critics of the bilingual advantage hypothesis argue that reported benefits in executive function tasks like the Simon or Flanker task often vanish when studies control strictly for socioeconomic status, parental education, and cultural immersion. Several high-powered pre-registered replications have failed to replicate statistically significant reaction-time differences between monolingual and multilingual adult cohorts.'

Which heading best encapsulates this paragraph?
options: The neural correlates of childhood simultaneous language acquisition
Methodological scepticism and non-replication of the executive function advantage
Statistical superiority of bilingual processing in auditory memory tests
Genetic predispositions to multilingual fluency in European populations
questions.explanation: The paragraph highlights criticisms of the bilingual advantage, pointing out confounding variables (socioeconomic status) and replication failures in large studies. 'Methodological scepticism and non-replication of the executive function advantage' encapsulates this perfectly.
